summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust, Inc. reported on Form 8-K that its indirect wholly owned subsidiary Ashford Philly LP completed the sale of the 263-room Embassy Suites Philadelphia Airport hotel to SSN 9000 Bartram Road LLC on October 6, 2026, under a purchase and sale agreement dated July 27, 2026. Gross consideration was approximately $26.0 million in cash, or about $25.2 million net of selling expenses, subject to customary prorations and adjustments. Roughly $24.6 million of proceeds repaid the mortgage lender under a loan secured by 12 hotels including the sold property, leaving limited net cash to the REIT. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Pro forma financials were furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The asset-sale deleveraging path and remaining secured-pool encumbrance are the watch items.
